verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Corrosive Charge and auto-trade at range without closing the gap; you win if you land E (Apprehend) and slow him with W before he can Disdain away.

brief.thesis: Urgot is a ranged poke champion (Q Corrosive Charge, 800 range) with a knockback escape (E Disdain) and an execute ultimate, while Darius is a melee champion whose entire kit depends on using E (Apprehend, 535 range) to drag him into range. This matchup is decided almost entirely by whether Darius's E lands before Urgot's poke and disengage tools are available, which is why the data comes back even — 46.5% win rate over 144 games, EVEN on lane and solo-kill.

theirWindow.when: after you whiff or save E (Apprehend)
theirWindow.what: Without E up you're a stationary target for Q (Corrosive Charge, cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, slows) and autos that trigger Echoing Flames — don't stand in poke range while your E is down, just farm and wait.

yourWindow.what: Immediately follow with W (Crippling Strike) to slow him so he can't kite with Purge, then stack Hemorrhage with Q and autos — his E (Disdain, cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) is now his only way out and it's a long cooldown if he already used it to engage or escape.

start.why: Measured at 48.2% win rate over 114 games and the clear majority pick (62.6%) — the sustain and damage offset the chip from autos and Corrosive Charge while you wait out E's cooldown.

boots.why: 48.2% win rate over 137 games and 77.8% pick rate — Urgot's damage is entirely physical (autos, Q, Echoing Flames blasts), so the flat reduction on basic attacks directly blunts his poke.

core.why: The highest-performing listed path (64.3% win rate over 14 games starts here); the active haste closes the distance Urgot otherwise keeps with Purge kiting.
Common second item across every listed core path — the move speed stacking helps you catch Urgot before E (Apprehend) is even needed, and the health buffers Echoing Flames chip.
Caps the top win-rate path at 64.3%; the damage-over-time conversion smooths out Urgot's burst from Disdain-into-Purge combos.

situational.when: you want built-in slow and mobility instead of Ghostblade's active to run down his kiting
the enemy team is stacking magic damage alongside Urgot and you need the magic resist
you're committing to all-ins and need anti-burst durability through his Q and Purge

runes.keystoneWhy: Once you land E (Apprehend) and slow with W, you're locked into an extended melee fight where Conqueror's stacking damage and healing conversion reward staying on top of him rather than trading at range.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite posts the best measured win rate of the listed combos (63.4% over the sample) — Ignite's guaranteed damage secures kills once you've committed E and R (Noxian Guillotine) on Urgot's Hemorrhage stacks, and Flash covers the gap if Disdain knocks you out of range.

playing.title: Hold E for the kill, not pokes
playing.detail: E (Apprehend) is on a 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown by rank — only fire it when you can immediately follow with W and a full combo, never to poke.

playing.title: Punish the pre-6 window
playing.detail: Before level 6 Urgot has no R and his only real escape is E (Disdain, cd 16-14.5s) — if you land your pull here he has very little to answer with.

playing.title: Dodge Corrosive Charge before closing
playing.detail: Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) explodes and slows — bait it on minions or sidestep the cast before you commit to walking him down.

playing.title: Respect Disdain after level 3
playing.detail: Once Urgot hits level 3, E (Disdain) tramples through your wave and, if it catches you directly, stops and hurls you away — don't approach in a straight line when it's up.

playing.title: Slow the instant you're in range
playing.detail: Use W (Crippling Strike) the moment E lands — the slow is what stops him from disengaging with W (Purge) while Echoing Flames ticks on you.

playing.title: Save R for stacked Hemorrhage
playing.detail: R (Noxian Guillotine) deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill — build to five stacks with Q and autos before you use it.

playing.title: Avoid level-1 auto trades
playing.detail: Echoing Flames punishes you for trading autos at level 1 before Doran's Blade sustain is online — farm safely until you can threaten with E.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, and summoner choices above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning for why each works in this matchup is my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Urgot’s passive ability while on level 1. After reaching level 3, be wary of his (E) while closing in on him to fight and kill him.
